.super-coder/ui/style.css: .pill.sprint-armed { color: var(--ok); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ok) 45%, var(--line)); }
.pill.sprint-paused { color: var(--warn); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warn) 45%, var(--line)); }
.sprint-action-form { flex: 1; display: grid; align-content: start; gap: .55rem; }
.sprint-actions { grid-area: actions; align-self: start; display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: .5rem; margin-top: .45rem; }
.sprint-audit-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: .45rem; padding: .35rem 0; }
.sprint-board-scroll { overflow-x: auto; padding: .9rem 1rem 1rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--bg); }

.sprint-column > h3 { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .4rem; margin: 0 0 .55rem; padding: 0 .25rem .45rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; font-size: .72rem; }
.sprint-column-empty { min-height: 7rem; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px dashed var(--line); color: var(--dim); font-size: .72rem; }
.sprint-columns { position: relative; z-index: 2; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(230px, 1fr)); gap: .8rem; }
.sprint-feed-detail { margin: 0 0 .55rem; padding: .55rem; background: var(--panel2); border-radius: 6px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.sprint-feed-row > summary { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; padding: .5rem 0; cursor: pointer; }
.sprint-feeds { display: grid; gap: 0; margin: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.sprint-long-text { white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; color: var(--ink); }
.sprint-preview-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; }

.sprint-stale-notice { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: .75rem; margin-bottom: .65rem; padding: .55rem .7rem; color: var(--warn); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--warn) 45%, var(--line)); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warn) 8%, var(--panel)); border-radius: 7px; }
.sprint-terminal-outcome { grid-column: 1 / -1; margin-top: .7rem; padding-top: .6rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }

.sprint-unit { width: 100%; min-height: 9rem; padding: .7rem; display: grid; align-content: start; gap: .4rem; text-align: left; color: var(--ink); background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 7px; cursor: pointer; }
.sprint-unit-meta, .sprint-unit-foot { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: .5rem; }
.sprint-unit-title > span:last-child { overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.sprint-unit:hover, .sprint-unit:focus-visible, .sprint-unit.lit { border-color: var(--accent); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 35%, transparent); }
.sprint-wire { fill: none; stroke: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 22%, transparent); stroke-width: 1.5; }
.sprint-wires { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 1; pointer-events: none; overflow: visible; }
.pill.sprint-health-progressing { color: var(--ok); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ok) 45%, var(--line)); }
.pill.sprint-health-infrastructure { color: var(--warn); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warn) 45%, var(--line)); }
.sprint-health-strip { grid-column: 1 / -1; margin-top: .7rem; padding-top: .65rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.sprint-health-strip-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: .75rem; margin-bottom: .5rem; font-size: .76rem; }
.sprint-health-roots { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr)); gap: .5rem; }
.sprint-health-root-head { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .35rem; }
.sprint-unit-health { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .35rem; padding-top: .35rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--line-soft); font-size: .7rem; }
.super-coder/scripts/dispatch.sh: ./sc sprint <cmd>        authenticated Sprints v2 actions (run without a command for the full verb list)
